mitigations/MIT-000078-interpreter-entry:
schema_version: 2.0.0
type: mitigation
id: MIT-000078
name:
  zh: 解释器入口、能力与内容审计治理
  en: Interpreter Entry Capability and Content-Audit Governance
summary:
  zh: 以最小解释器入口、应用控制、受限语言/会话、脚本信任和受保护内容审计，减少正常谱系借用与短驻语义空间。
  en: Reduce normal-lineage borrowing and transient semantics through least interpreter entry application control constrained
    language or sessions script trust and protected content auditing.
description:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 本缓解不主张按名称全面禁用解释器，因为管理、构建和应用工作流常依赖它们。控制应把谁能从何入口调用哪种能力，与批准脚本/模块、目录、网络目的地、资产范围和时间绑定；对支持的平台使用应用控制、签名策略、PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage/JEA、最小
      RBAC 或等价受限执行环境，并启用可保护的脚本块、运行时与进程审计。
    en: This mitigation does not recommend disabling interpreters by name because operations, builds, and applications depend
      on them. Controls bind who can invoke which capability through what entry to approved scripts or modules, directories,
      network destinations, asset scope, and time. Where supported, use application control, signing policy, PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage
      or JEA, least RBAC, or equivalent constrained environments, and enable protected script-block, runtime, and process
      auditing.
  - zh: 控制目标是让攻击者无法仅凭签名解释器或正常父体获得全语言能力，让 stdin、管道与内存输入也进入审计和策略，并把例外限制在具体身份、内容与有效期。日志可能包含秘密，必须加密、最小访问和设置保留期；响应时先保存入口、内容指纹和结果谱系，再终止会话与撤销相关令牌。
    en: The objective is to prevent a signed interpreter or normal parent alone from conferring full-language capability,
      bring standard input, pipelines, and memory-fed content into audit and policy, and constrain exceptions to concrete
      identity, content, and validity. Logs may contain secrets and require encryption, least access, and retention limits.
      During response preserve entry, content fingerprint, and outcome lineage before terminating sessions and revoking related
      tokens.
domains:
- enterprise
measures:
- key: interpreter-entry-least-privilege
  name:
    zh: 解释器入口最小权限
    en: Interpreter Entry Least Privilege
  description:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 盘点用户、服务、Office/应用插件、管理代理、构建器和远程接口对解释器的调用路径，删除无业务需要入口，并把允许主体绑定到资产、目录、脚本/模块和目的地。
      en: Inventory user service Office or application plug-in management-agent builder and remote-interface paths to interpreters
        remove entries without business need and bind allowed principals to assets directories scripts or modules and destinations.
  control_type: exposure-reduction
- key: interpreter-capability-and-trust
  name:
    zh: 解释器能力与内容信任约束
    en: Interpreter Capability and Content Trust Constraints
  description:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 以应用控制、签名/哈希、受限语言、JEA 或沙箱把未批准脚本与内联内容限制为最小能力；批准例外使用具体内容身份与到期时间，不能永久放行解释器二进制。
      en: Use application control signature or hash constrained language JEA or sandboxing to limit unapproved scripts and
        inline content to least capability; bind approved exceptions to concrete content identity and expiry rather than permanently
        allowing an interpreter binary.
  control_type: preventive
- key: transient-content-audit
  name:
    zh: 短驻内容与结果审计
    en: Transient Content and Outcome Audit
  description:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 启用 Script Block/AMSI、runtime audit、execve 与完整进程谱系，记录 stdin/管道来源和网络取得内容的受保护指纹，并把调用与结果连接；对敏感原文加密和字段级授权。
      en: Enable Script Block or AMSI runtime audit execve and complete process lineage record standard-input or pipeline
        origin and protected fingerprints of network-fetched content and join invocation to outcome; encrypt sensitive raw
        content and apply field-level authorization.
  control_type: detective-support
- key: interpreter-session-response
  name:
    zh: 解释器会话证据化响应
    en: Evidence-Preserving Interpreter Session Response
  description:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 发现异常时保存祖先、主体、命令/内容哈希、模块、网络与子进程，随后终止会话、撤销令牌、隔离入口并按批准基线恢复；不得只删除临时文件。
      en: On anomaly preserve ancestry principal command or content hash modules network and child processes then terminate
        the session revoke tokens isolate the entry and restore from an approved baseline; do not only delete temporary files.
  control_type: containment
applications:
- target_ref: NJT-0065
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 建立解释器入口清单和按资产职责的允许矩阵，对未批准来源或内容实施受限能力，并统一采集入口—语义—结果链。对必须使用的解释器不做名称级放行，变更需要具体脚本/模块、主体、目标和有效期审批。
      en: Maintain an interpreter-entry inventory and asset-role allowance matrix constrain unapproved origins or content
        and collect a unified entry-semantics-outcome chain. Do not allow required interpreters by name; changes require approval
        for concrete script or module principal target and validity.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 缩小可借用入口和可执行能力，使恶意指令必须触发策略差异或留下可关联内容，同时保留合法管理与构建功能。
      en: Narrows borrowable entries and executable capability forcing malicious instructions to trigger a policy difference
        or leave correlatable content while preserving legitimate operations and builds.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 异构解释器能力不同，完整内容日志可能泄露秘密；被攻陷的批准脚本、签名者或管理代理仍可产生一致元数据，需要完整性与结果检测配合。
      en: Heterogeneous interpreters expose different controls and full-content logs can leak secrets; a compromised approved
        script signer or management agent can still produce consistent metadata requiring integrity and outcome detection.
- target_ref: NJS-0065-001
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 将允许项绑定完整祖先、主体、目录、脚本/模块哈希、目的地和资产角色；WMI、服务、Office 与管理代理只能调用明确列出的解释能力，偏离时降权或阻断。
      en: Bind allowances to full ancestry principal directory script or module hash destination and asset role; WMI services
        Office and management agents may invoke only explicitly listed interpreter capabilities with divergence constrained
        or blocked.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 正常父级和签名不再足以掩护任意指令，攻击者必须同时破坏或复制更多独立控制面。
      en: A normal parent and signature no longer shelter arbitrary instructions and the adversary must compromise or reproduce
        more independent control surfaces.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 动态运维和构建会频繁变化，过窄允许矩阵可能中断业务；应使用到期例外和审计模式逐步收敛。
      en: Dynamic operations and builds change frequently and an overly narrow matrix can interrupt business; converge through
        expiring exceptions and audit mode.
- target_ref: NJS-0065-002
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 对 stdin、`-Command`、管道、下载字符串和内存脚本启用运行时内容检查或默认受限能力；若业务需要内联，要求受控主体、内容指纹、目的地与审批，并保留结果谱系。
      en: Apply runtime content inspection or constrained capability by default to standard input command parameters pipelines
        downloaded strings and memory scripts; when inline use is required bind principal content fingerprint destination
        and approval and retain outcome lineage.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 把策略和检测移动到短驻语义存在的时点，使无独立脚本不能绕过能力控制或调查链。
      en: Moves policy and detection to the moment transient semantics exist so absence of a standalone script cannot bypass
        capability control or the investigative chain.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 某些嵌入运行时不暴露完整内容，关闭内联能力会影响安装器与自动化；日志脱敏或哈希可能降低事后解释能力。
      en: Some embedded runtimes do not expose complete content and disabling inline capability can affect installers and
        automation; redaction or hashing can reduce post-incident interpretation.
- target_ref: NJT-0244
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 对通过解释器执行的系统信息发现，把 OS、主板、处理器与有限补丁查询限定在有职责的支持和部署身份、具体脚本与主机范围内；对未批准脚本保留受限能力，并采集受保护的查询语义。台账区分 OSArchitecture、处理器和修补来源，避免把允许一种诊断任务扩展为任意主机画像权限。
      en: For interpreter-mediated System Information Discovery, bind OS, baseboard, processor, and limited patch queries
        to responsible support or deployment identities, concrete scripts, and host scope. Retain constrained capabilities
        for unapproved scripts and protected query-semantics auditing. Distinguish OSArchitecture, processor facts, and patch
        sources in the register so approval for one diagnostic task does not become authority for arbitrary host profiling.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 减少攻击者可借用的任意解释执行入口，并使看似正常的属性查询更易同真实作业核验。直接互操作能力被限制时，攻击者需要转用仍可调用的受控命令、其他执行路径或已被攻陷的批准脚本；这些变化可产生额外策略或调查证据。
      en: Reduce arbitrary interpreter entries available to the adversary and make ordinary-looking attribute queries easier
        to verify against real work. When direct interop is constrained, the adversary must use still-callable controlled
        commands, another execution path, or a compromised approved script, potentially producing additional policy or investigative
        evidence.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 该应用只约束解释器路径，不阻止普通程序的基本系统 getter，也不保证 ConstrainedLanguage 禁止 CIM 或全部诊断命令。合法安装和修复依赖系统属性，批准身份或签名脚本被盗仍可查询；日志不含返回缓冲区，部署必须测试兼容性并保护可能包含敏感参数的内容。
      en: This application constrains interpreter paths rather than basic system getters in ordinary programs, and ConstrainedLanguage
        is not assumed to block CIM or all diagnostics. Legitimate installation and repair need system attributes, and stolen
        approved identities or signed scripts can still query. Logs lack return buffers, and deployment must test compatibility
        and protect content that can contain sensitive parameters.
- target_ref: NJT-0246
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 对通过 PowerShell 提供的网络配置支持入口，使用现有解释器入口治理、应用控制与 JEA 将允许命令绑定批准的 Get-NetIPConfiguration 包装函数、脚本或模块、主体、目标主机及期限。按任务限制接口、compartment
        与 CimSession 范围，避免给仅需本地诊断的支持身份开放任意远程命令和任意代码能力。保存实际参数与脚本内容，并在需要确认暴露字段时另行验证结果采集。
      en: For network-configuration support exposed through PowerShell, apply existing interpreter-entry governance, application
        control, and JEA to bind permitted commands to approved Get-NetIPConfiguration wrappers, scripts or modules, principals,
        target hosts, and validity. Restrict interface, compartment, and CimSession scope by task instead of giving local-diagnostic
        support arbitrary remote commands or code capability. Preserve actual arguments and script content, separately validating
        result capture when exposed fields must be confirmed.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 攻击者借用支持身份与正常脚本外观发起任意接口画像或跨主机调查的机会减少，偏离批准入口与参数的请求更容易核验。该应用控制的是可治理的解释器执行面与调查问责，不把受限语言当成所有网络查询的禁止开关；启用日志改善请求证据，只有独立结果采集才改善具体返回证据。
      en: The opportunity to borrow support identities and ordinary script appearance for arbitrary interface profiling or
        cross-host surveys decreases, while requests outside approved entries and parameters become easier to verify. This
        application controls governable interpreter execution and inquiry accountability rather than treating constrained
        language as a universal network-query ban. Logging improves request evidence; only independent result capture improves
        evidence of particular returns.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 普通本地应用、ipconfig 和原生 getter 仍可能读取基础配置，JEA 不能约束未通过该入口执行的进程。已控制的批准模块或代理也可能产生一致元数据；配置读取、DNS 成功和端到端可达性仍须分开。过窄的接口与远程会话允许项会影响排障，应先验证兼容性、保留有期限的支持例外，并保护可能含网络详情的日志。
      en: Ordinary local applications, ipconfig, and native getters may still read basic configuration, and JEA does not constrain
        processes outside its entry. Compromised approved modules or agents can produce consistent metadata. Configuration
        reads, DNS success, and end-to-end reachability remain separate. Narrow interface and remote-session allowances can
        impair troubleshooting, requiring compatibility validation, expiring support exceptions, and protection of logs containing
        network details.

schema_version: 2.0.0
type: technique
id: NJT-0122
name:
  zh: 本地分析环境条件化规避
  en: Local Analysis-Environment Conditioned Evasion
summary:
  zh: 攻击者在本地检查虚拟化、用户活动或时间证据，并在疑似分析环境中退出、诱骗或保留核心载荷。
  en: Adversaries inspect local virtualization, user-activity, or timing evidence and exit, deceive, or withhold core payloads
    in a suspected analysis environment.
aliases:
- Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion
- T1497
classification:
  tactic_refs:
  - TA0005
  origin:
    kind: attack-adapted
    source_attack_id: T1497
    source_attack_version: '19.1'
  decision_ref: DEC-TA0005-T1497
definition_and_concept:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 本地分析环境条件化规避是已经在主机或来宾执行的程序采集本地硬件与虚拟化工件、人类交互证据或时间真实性信号，判断当前环境是否为自动分析、沙箱或短生命周期测试，并让判断控制退出、诱饵、等待、解码或核心载荷释放。直接目的在于让分析环境观察到与真实目标不同且不完整的行为路径。
    en: Local Analysis-Environment Conditioned Evasion is behavior in which a program already executing on a host or guest collects local hardware and virtualization artifacts, human-interaction evidence, or temporal-realism signals, judges whether the environment is automated analysis, a sandbox, or a short-lived test, and uses the judgment to control exit, decoy, waiting, decoding, or core-payload release. Its immediate purpose is to make the analysis environment observe a different and incomplete behavior path from a real target.
  - zh: 概念锚是本地证据采集、分析环境判断、条件分支以及核心结果差分。查询虚拟机信息、读取鼠标或 GetTickCount 本身只是环境发现；只有它们实际决定后继行为才属于本技术。远程服务识别蜜罐归 NJT-0104，调试器专用检测归 NJT-0106，单纯消耗时间归 NJT-0107，正向目标匹配护栏归 NJT-0109。
    en: The conceptual anchor is local evidence collection, analysis-environment judgment, a conditional branch, and a differential in core outcome. Querying virtual-machine information, reading mouse state, or calling GetTickCount alone is environment discovery; it belongs here only when it actually decides successor behavior. Remote service assessment of a honeypot belongs to NJT-0104, debugger-specific checks to NJT-0106, mere time consumption to NJT-0107, and positive target-matching guardrails to NJT-0109.
stealth_characteristics:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 本地分析环境条件化规避让同一样本在沙箱中只退出、休眠、显示诱饵或保留下一阶段，而在真实型环境继续。系统指纹分支利用 VM 设备、驱动、进程和文件的静态组合；人类活动分支要求自然键鼠、窗口或文档导航；时间真实性分支利用运行时间、睡眠前后时钟或指令耗时识别加速与短分析窗口。单一沙箱运行因此可能完全看不到核心能力。
    en: Local Analysis-Environment Conditioned Evasion causes the same sample to exit, sleep, display a decoy, or withhold a next stage in a sandbox while continuing in a real-like environment. System-fingerprint branches use combinations of VM devices, drivers, processes, and files. Human-activity branches require natural keyboard, mouse, window, or document navigation. Temporal-realism branches use uptime, clocks before and after sleep, or instruction timing to identify acceleration and short analysis horizons. One sandbox run can therefore miss core capability entirely.
  - zh: 查询 API、硬件与产品工件、交互事件与自然度、运行时间和多时钟差、分支覆盖、解码缓冲区、子进程、网络和载荷阶段仍可观察。多环境逐变量实验、真实交互模拟和一致时间加速可以恢复因果；攻击者使用目标专属组合、外部事件或高度非确定分支时仍会形成盲区。
    en: Query APIs, hardware and product artifacts, interaction events and naturalness, uptime and multi-clock differentials, branch coverage, decoded buffers, child processes, networking, and payload stages remain observable. Multi-environment one-variable-at-a-time experiments, realistic interaction simulation, and coherent time acceleration can recover causality. Blind spots remain when the adversary uses target-specific combinations, external events, or highly nondeterministic branches.
scope_boundary_definition:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 纳入本地程序有意采集系统、交互或时间证据以识别分析环境，并由判断实际改变核心后继行为的情况。判定需要证据读取、分支或阈值、至少两个受控环境/条件下的结果差分，或来源直接记录的检查—退出/释放链；一个 VM API、长 sleep 或无人输入单独不足以成立。
    en: Scope includes deliberate local collection of system, interaction, or timing evidence to identify an analysis environment where the judgment actually changes core successor behavior. Classification requires evidence reads, a branch or threshold, and outcome differentials under at least two controlled environments or conditions, or a directly documented check-to-exit-or-release chain. One VM API, long sleep, or absence of input alone is insufficient.
  - zh: 合法许可、硬件兼容性、性能调优、辅助功能、自动化测试、无人值守业务和正常启动检查是反例。系统/虚拟化特征归 NJS-0122-001，人类活动充分性归 NJS-0122-002，时间真实性归 NJS-0122-003；远程蜜罐、调试器、普通延迟与正向目标护栏分别保留相邻边界。
    en: Legitimate licensing, hardware compatibility, performance tuning, accessibility, automated testing, unattended business workloads, and normal startup checks are counterexamples. System or virtualization features belong to NJS-0122-001, human-activity sufficiency to NJS-0122-002, and temporal realism to NJS-0122-003. Remote honeypots, debuggers, ordinary delay, and positive target guardrails retain adjacent boundaries.
application_scenarios_and_threat_model:
  application_scenarios:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 恶意 dropper 可检查 VMware/Cuckoo 工件后不释放载荷，要求用户滚动文档、点击单元格或产生自然鼠标/键盘轨迹后才解码，或比较 GetTickCount、sleep 前后时钟与指令耗时来识别短生命周期和时间加速。IRONGATE 直接展示 VMware/Cuckoo 指纹门控，Upatre 直接展示运行时间不足时退出。
      en: A malicious dropper may refuse to release a payload after checking VMware or Cuckoo artifacts, require a user to scroll a document, click cells, or produce natural mouse and keyboard traces before decoding, or compare GetTickCount, clocks before and after sleep, and instruction timing to identify short-lived or accelerated time. IRONGATE directly demonstrates VMware or Cuckoo fingerprint gating, and Upatre directly demonstrates exit under insufficient uptime.
  threat_model:
    attacker_model:
      paragraphs:
      - zh: 攻击者需要了解常见沙箱硬件、产品工件、交互模拟和时间加速实现，并选择足够稳定的组合阈值控制分支。真实企业大量使用虚拟化、服务主机可能无人交互、刚启动设备运行时间短，过强判定会失去真实目标；多维组合提高精度但增加开发、兼容性与调试成本。透明插桩、环境多样化和主动实验会降低效果。
        en: The adversary needs knowledge of common sandbox hardware, product artifacts, interaction simulation, and time-acceleration implementations and must choose sufficiently stable combinations and thresholds for branching. Real enterprises use virtualization extensively, service hosts can be unattended, and newly started devices have short uptime, so aggressive classification loses real targets. Combining dimensions improves precision but raises development, compatibility, and debugging cost. Transparent instrumentation, environment diversity, and active experimentation reduce the effect.
    defender_model:
      paragraphs:
      - zh: 防守方可观察硬件/驱动/进程/文件查询、交互读取与注入、多个时钟和运行时间、sleep 与循环、分支 ID、载荷阶段、内存、子进程和网络，并在可重复沙箱、裸机与真实型环境逐项改变变量。只有一个短时运行、键鼠模拟固定、时钟加速不一致、样本依赖外部事件或没有分支覆盖时形成盲区；合法兼容性和自动化软件需要签名与产品基线。
        en: Defenders can observe hardware, driver, process, and file queries, interaction reads and injection, multiple clocks and uptime, sleeps and loops, branch identities, payload stages, memory, child processes, and networking and vary one condition at a time across repeatable sandbox, bare-metal, and real-like environments. Blind spots arise with one short run, static keyboard or mouse simulation, inconsistent time acceleration, external-event dependencies, or missing branch coverage. Legitimate compatibility and automation software require signing and product baselines.
stealth_mechanisms:
- mechanism_ref: NM-BT
  role: primary
  summary:
    zh: 分析环境判断把核心行为门控在沙箱观察之外
    en: Analysis-environment assessment gates core behavior outside sandbox observation
  analysis:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 攻击者在核心路径前判断环境，疑似分析时退出或保留载荷；痕迹从完整执行缩减为检查与替代分支，动态分析无法观察真实能力，形成行为透明。
      en: The adversary assesses the environment before the core path and exits or withholds the payload when analysis is
        suspected. Traces contract from full execution to checks and an alternate branch, preventing dynamic analysis from
        observing real capability and producing Behavioral Transparency.
  evidence_refs:

  - REF-000445

subtechnique_taxonomy:
  narrative:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 子技术按环境证据的真实性模型与验证实验划分。NJS-0122-001“系统指纹分析环境判别”使用硬件、驱动、进程、文件或产品工件，需要系统特征变体与裸机/虚机对照；NJS-0122-002“人类活动充分性门控”使用键鼠、窗口、文档导航或近期输入，需要自然交互脚本和事件语义；NJS-0122-003“时间真实性校验”使用运行时间、多时钟、sleep 或指令耗时，需要一致时间加速和时钟差分。
      en: Children are divided by the realism model of environment evidence and its validation experiment. NJS-0122-001 System-Fingerprint Analysis Classification uses hardware, drivers, processes, files, or product artifacts and requires system-feature variants plus bare-metal or virtual-machine controls. NJS-0122-002 Human-Activity Sufficiency Gating uses keyboard, mouse, window, document-navigation, or recent-input evidence and requires natural interaction scripts and event semantics. NJS-0122-003 Temporal Realism Verification uses uptime, multiple clocks, sleeps, or instruction timing and requires coherent time acceleration and clock differentials.
    - zh: 操作系统、VM 产品、API 名称、鼠标字段和具体秒数只是实现。三项可以组合成综合环境评分，但各自改变不同证据与实验控制，不能由一个通用“重跑样本”Analytic 替代。
      en: Operating system, VM product, API name, mouse field, and concrete seconds are implementations. The three children can combine into one environment score, but each changes different evidence and experimental controls and cannot be replaced by one generic rerun-the-sample analytic.

    en: Scope includes local system artifacts used to judge an analysis environment where the judgment actually changes core successor behavior. Legitimate licensing, hardware compatibility, performance optimization, virtualization support, and ordinary system discovery are counterexamples. User-interaction sufficiency belongs to NJS-0122-002, clocks and uptime to NJS-0122-003, and debugger-specific checks to NJT-0106.

      paragraphs:
      - zh: 防守方可记录系统查询、被访问工件、环境配置、分支和载荷阶段，并在裸机、不同 VM 与移除特征的环境重执行。仅一个固定模板、查询未插桩或样本使用目标专属特征时形成盲区。

      en: The adversary maps the environment to an analysis class through system artifacts and takes an exit branch, leaving the sandbox with queries and decoys but no real payload. summary: {zh: 攻击者要求自然键鼠、窗口、文档导航或近期输入达到充分条件后才释放核心功能，以排除无人自动分析环境。, en: Adversaries require natural keyboard mouse window document-navigation or recent-input evidence to satisfy a condition before releasing core functionality and exclude unattended automated analysis.}

definition_and_concept:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 人类活动充分性门控是攻击者采集最近输入、鼠标轨迹、按键节奏、窗口焦点、对话框点击、滚动或工作表导航，并要求这些事件达到自然交互条件后才继续解码、执行或联网。直接目的在于区分真实有人使用的终端与无人或机械交互的沙箱；稳定变量是交互证据的充分性与自然度，而不是具体设备或 UI 控件。
    en: Human-Activity Sufficiency Gating is an evasion sub-technique in which an adversary collects recent input, mouse paths, keystroke cadence, window focus, dialog clicks, scrolling, or worksheet navigation and requires those events to satisfy a natural-interaction condition before decoding, executing, or networking. Its immediate purpose is to distinguish a genuinely user-driven endpoint from an unattended or mechanically interacted sandbox. The stable variable is sufficiency and naturalness of interaction evidence rather than a specific device or UI control.
stealth_characteristics:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 人类活动充分性门控让只等待固定时间或随机点击的沙箱停留在诱饵/空白分支，而真实用户完成自然动作后触发核心行为。交互读取、事件序列、阈值、分支和载荷差分仍可观察；真实化脚本与多种交互会限制效果，但无人值守业务终端可能合法缺少活动。
    en: Human-Activity Sufficiency Gating leaves a sandbox that only waits or clicks randomly in a decoy or blank branch while a real user's natural actions trigger core behavior. Interaction reads, event sequences, thresholds, branches, and payload differentials remain observable. Realistic scripts and diverse interaction constrain the effect, while unattended business endpoints can legitimately lack activity.
scope_boundary_definition:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 纳入本地用户活动证据被用于判断分析环境且实际控制后继行为。普通用户执行、可用性检查、屏幕锁定、休眠策略和合法需要交互的软件是反例。静态系统工件归 NJS-0122-001，运行时间/时钟归 NJS-0122-003；单纯诱导用户点击可与社会工程或用户执行共映射。
    en: Scope includes local user-activity evidence used to classify an analysis environment and actually control successor behavior. Ordinary user execution, usability checks, screen lock, idle policy, and legitimate interactive software are counterexamples. Static system artifacts belong to NJS-0122-001, uptime or clocks to NJS-0122-003, and merely inducing a user click can co-map to social engineering or user execution.
application_scenarios_and_threat_model:
  application_scenarios:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 恶意文档可要求滚动、切换工作表或点击特定单元格，dropper 可读取 LastInputInfo、鼠标路径和按键时间，只有活动看起来自然时释放载荷。WildFire 研究记录多家族使用这些交互检查并需要主动键鼠/文档自动化。
      en: A malicious document can require scrolling, changing worksheets, or clicking specific cells, and a dropper can read LastInputInfo, mouse paths, and keystroke timing and release a payload only when activity appears natural. WildFire research documents malware families using these interaction checks and requiring active keyboard, mouse, or document automation.
  threat_model:
    attacker_model:
      paragraphs:
      - zh: 攻击者需选择真实用户常有而沙箱难仿真的交互，并容忍不同辅助功能、触屏、远程桌面和无人值守主机。过高阈值会错过真实目标，交互规则也可能被分析人员重放。
        en: The adversary needs interaction common for real users but difficult for sandboxes to emulate and must tolerate accessibility, touch, remote desktop, and unattended hosts. Excessive thresholds miss real targets, and analysts can replay interaction rules.
    defender_model:
      paragraphs:
      - zh: 防守方可记录输入 API、窗口/文档事件、注入动作、分支和后继结果，并使用多种自然节奏与操作序列重跑。隐私限制、加密桌面、远程会话或事件未插桩时形成盲区；合法交互软件需产品基线。
        en: Defenders can record input APIs, window or document events, injected actions, branches, and successor outcomes and rerun with varied natural cadence and operation sequences. Privacy limits, secure desktops, remote sessions, or uninstrumented events create blind spots. Legitimate interactive software requires product baselines.
stealth_mechanisms:
- mechanism_ref: NM-BT
  role: primary
  summary: {zh: 自然交互条件把核心行为隔离在无人沙箱观察之外, en: Natural-interaction conditions isolate core behavior from unattended sandbox observation}
  analysis:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 攻击者把真实载荷放在交互充分分支后，自动分析只产生少量查询和等待痕迹，无法进入用户驱动路径，形成行为透明。受控交互变体和分支覆盖可以恢复隐藏结果。
      en: The adversary places the real payload behind an interaction-sufficiency branch, leaving automated analysis with only a few queries and waiting traces and preventing entry into the user-driven path, producing Behavioral Transparency. Controlled interaction variants and branch coverage recover the hidden outcome.
  evidence_refs: [REF-000410, REF-000443]

  limitations:

    - zh: Unit 42 直接描述多家族交互检查和防守实验，但未为每个交互模式提供归因案例。活动缺失可能来自服务器、自动化工作负载或用户离席；必须观察注入交互改变了核心结果，不能按 LastInputInfo 查询单独定性。
      en: Unit 42 directly describes interaction checks across malware families and defensive experiments but does not provide an attributed case for every interaction pattern. Missing activity can result from servers, automated workloads, or an absent user. Evidence must show injected interaction changing the core outcome and cannot classify a LastInputInfo query alone.

schema_version: 2.0.0
type: evasion-subtechnique
id: NJS-0122-003
name: {zh: 时间真实性校验, en: Temporal Realism Verification}
summary: {zh: 攻击者比较系统运行时间、多时钟、睡眠或指令耗时，在时间短暂或加速不一致时退出或保留核心载荷。, en: Adversaries compare system uptime multiple clocks sleeps or instruction timing and exit or withhold core payloads when time is short-lived or inconsistently accelerated.}
aliases: []
parent_ref: NJT-0122
lineage: {attck_subtechnique_inherited: false}
definition_and_concept:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 时间真实性校验是攻击者读取系统运行时间、墙钟、单调时钟、时间戳计数器、sleep 前后差值或计算循环耗时，并判断环境是否因刚启动、分析窗口过短、sleep 跳过或 VM 指令开销而不真实，再控制退出、等待或载荷释放。直接目的在于识别沙箱时间模型；稳定变量是时间证据一致性，而不是固定秒数或延迟 API。
    en: Temporal Realism Verification is an evasion sub-technique in which an adversary reads system uptime, wall clock, monotonic clock, timestamp counter, before-and-after sleep differences, or computation-loop timing, judges whether the environment is unrealistic because it has just booted, has a short analysis horizon, skips sleep, or adds VM instruction cost, and then controls exit, waiting, or payload release. Its immediate purpose is to identify the sandbox's time model. The stable variable is consistency of temporal evidence rather than a fixed number of seconds or delay API.
stealth_characteristics:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 时间真实性校验让短时沙箱在样本到达恶意路径前结束，或在加速 sleep 时因多时钟不一致被识别。运行时间、时钟读取、阈值、循环资源、分支和加速前后载荷差分仍可观察；一致控制全部时间源和延长分析会限制效果，但成本高。
    en: Temporal Realism Verification causes a short sandbox to end before the sample reaches its malicious path or exposes sleep acceleration through inconsistency among clocks. Uptime, clock reads, thresholds, loop resources, branches, and payload differentials before and after acceleration remain observable. Coherent control of every time source and longer analysis constrain the effect but are costly.
scope_boundary_definition:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 纳入时间证据被用于判断分析环境并实际改变核心后继行为。普通 sleep、业务调度、速率限制、许可证时间和纯资源消耗是反例。没有环境判别的延迟归 NJT-0107；系统工件归 NJS-0122-001，用户活动归 NJS-0122-002。
    en: Scope includes timing evidence used to classify an analysis environment and actually change core successor behavior. Ordinary sleep, business scheduling, rate limiting, license time, and pure resource consumption are counterexamples. Delay without environment judgment belongs to NJT-0107, system artifacts to NJS-0122-001, and user activity to NJS-0122-002.
application_scenarios_and_threat_model:
  application_scenarios:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: Upatre 调用 GetTickCount，并在系统运行不足约十二分钟时退出；WildFire 改写运行时间后样本继续恶意例程。其他样本可比较 sleep 前后多个时钟或高 VM-exit 指令耗时识别时间加速和虚拟化。
      en: Upatre called GetTickCount and exited when system uptime was below roughly twelve minutes; after WildFire changed the uptime, the sample continued its malicious routine. Other samples can compare multiple clocks before and after sleep or timing of high-VM-exit instructions to identify acceleration and virtualization.
  threat_model:
    attacker_model:
      paragraphs:
      - zh: 攻击者需选择真实环境和沙箱分布不同的时间信号，并处理休眠、刚重启和低性能主机。固定阈值会漂移，多时钟校验增加代码和兼容成本；长时间运行与一致加速会削弱判断。
        en: The adversary needs a timing signal whose distributions differ between real environments and sandboxes and must handle sleep, recent reboot, and slow hosts. Fixed thresholds drift, and multiclock validation increases code and compatibility cost. Long execution and coherent acceleration weaken the judgment.
    defender_model:
      paragraphs:
      - zh: 防守方可记录所有时钟/运行时间读取、sleep、循环、CPU 与分支，并在原速、统一加速和不同 uptime 环境比较结果。硬件时钟不可控、样本非确定或分析预算短时形成盲区。
        en: Defenders can record all clock and uptime reads, sleeps, loops, CPU, and branches and compare outcomes under real time, coherent acceleration, and different uptime environments. Uncontrollable hardware clocks, nondeterministic samples, or short analysis budgets create blind spots.
stealth_mechanisms:
- mechanism_ref: NM-BT
  role: primary
  summary: {zh: 时间真实性判断把载荷隔离在短时或加速分析窗口之外, en: Temporal-realism judgment isolates payloads beyond short or accelerated analysis windows}
  analysis:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 攻击者用时间一致性决定是否进入核心路径，沙箱看到早退或持续等待而真实环境释放载荷。分析观察被时间条件收缩，形成行为透明；统一时钟控制和结果差分可恢复隐藏路径。
      en: The adversary uses temporal consistency to decide whether to enter the core path, leaving a sandbox with early exit or continued waiting while a real environment releases the payload. Analysis observation contracts under the timing condition, producing Behavioral Transparency. Coherent clock control and outcome differentials recover the hidden path.
  evidence_refs: [REF-000410, REF-000443, REF-000445]
  confidence: high
defense: {detections: {coverage: available, strategy_refs: [DET-000119]}, mitigations: {coverage: available, mitigation_refs: [MIT-000120]}}
evidence: {claim_refs: [CLM-000657], case_refs: [CASE-000165], reference_refs: [REF-000410, REF-000443, REF-000445]}
research:
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: Upatre 直接证明 uptime 门控和防守改写后的结果，但十二分钟不是通用阈值。真实新启动设备和短命工作负载可满足同样条件；必须用受控时间变化证明后继差分，不能把 sleep 或 GetTickCount 本身视为恶意。
      en: Upatre directly establishes uptime gating and the outcome after defensive rewriting, but twelve minutes is not a universal threshold. Real newly booted devices and ephemeral workloads can satisfy the same condition. Controlled timing changes must establish the successor differential, and sleep or GetTickCount alone is not malicious.

mitigations/MIT-000120-analysis-environm:
schema_version: 2.0.0
type: mitigation
id: MIT-000120
name:
  zh: 分析环境真实性与差分执行
  en: Analysis-Environment Fidelity and Differential Execution
summary:
  zh: 提高分析环境真实性，使用多环境差分与透明插桩恢复被条件化隐藏的行为。
  en: Increase analysis-environment fidelity and use multi-environment differential and transparent instrumentation to recover
    conditionally hidden behavior.
description:
  paragraphs:
  - zh: 本缓解减少稳定沙箱工件，模拟真实用户活动与时间，使用透明多层插桩，并在多个环境重执行样本比较结果。网络和资源受隔离，未知分支可安全继续。
    en: This mitigation reduces stable sandbox artifacts, simulates realistic user activity and time, uses transparent multilayer
      instrumentation, and re-executes samples across environments for comparison. Networking and resources are isolated and
      unknown branches can continue safely.
domains:
- enterprise
measures:
- key: high-fidelity-analysis-environment
  name:
    zh: 高真实性分析环境
    en: High-Fidelity Analysis Environment
  description:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 多样化硬件、软件、用户活动与时间特征，避免固定模板和明显分析工件。
      en: Diversify hardware, software, user activity, and timing features and avoid fixed templates and obvious analysis
        artifacts.
  control_type: detective-support
- key: controlled-environment-differential
  name:
    zh: 受控环境差分
    en: Controlled Environment Differential
  description:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 在多个环境重执行同一样本，逐项改变条件并比较核心行为、内存和网络结果。
      en: Re-execute one sample across environments, vary conditions individually, and compare core behavior, memory, and
        network outcomes.
  control_type: detective-support
applications:
- target_ref: NJT-0122
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 使用多样化真实环境和差分执行，隐藏分析标志并捕获检查后的不同分支。
      en: Use diverse real-like environments and differential execution, conceal analysis indicators, and capture different
        branches after checks.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 单一沙箱特征不再稳定触发规避，隐藏载荷更可能在至少一个环境暴露并与检查关联。
      en: One sandbox feature no longer triggers evasion reliably, and hidden payloads are more likely to appear in at least
        one environment and be correlated with checks.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 高真实性环境成本高，攻击者可使用目标专属条件或外部情报，差分执行也受非确定行为影响。
      en: High-fidelity environments are costly, adversaries can use target-specific conditions or external intelligence,
        and differential execution is affected by nondeterministic behavior.
- target_ref: NJS-0122-001
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 多样化硬件、固件、驱动、进程和文件模板，使用裸机/VM 对照并逐项移除可疑工件，同时以透明插桩记录系统查询与分支。
      en: Diversify hardware, firmware, driver, process, and file templates, use bare-metal and VM controls and remove suspicious artifacts one at a time, and record system queries and branches through transparent instrumentation.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 单一 VM 或产品指纹不能稳定阻止载荷，多环境结果暴露控制分支。
      en: One VM or product fingerprint cannot reliably suppress the payload, and multi-environment outcomes expose the controlling branch.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 维护多环境成本高，目标专属硬件和企业虚拟化会扩大分布，底层透明性无法完全保证。
      en: Maintaining multiple environments is expensive, target-specific hardware and enterprise virtualization widen distributions, and lower-layer transparency cannot be guaranteed completely.
- target_ref: NJS-0122-002
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 为样本提供多种自然键鼠、窗口和文档交互脚本，随机化节奏与位置并记录输入读取、分支和后继结果。
      en: Provide samples with varied natural keyboard, mouse, window, and document-interaction scripts, randomize cadence and position, and record input reads, branches, and successor outcomes.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 无人沙箱不再因缺少人类活动停留在诱饵分支，核心载荷更可能在至少一种交互条件下暴露。
      en: An unattended sandbox no longer remains in a decoy branch merely for lacking human activity, and the core payload is more likely to appear under at least one interaction condition.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 复杂 UI、物理设备和远程会话难以真实模拟，交互采集涉及隐私，攻击者可要求目标专属工作流。
      en: Complex UI, physical devices, and remote sessions are difficult to emulate realistically, interaction collection raises privacy concerns, and adversaries can require target-specific workflows.
- target_ref: NJS-0122-003
  use:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 同时虚拟化或记录墙钟、单调时钟、TSC 与 uptime，在原速和一致加速环境重执行，并为资源循环设置安全预算而不提前终止分支。
      en: Virtualize or record wall clock, monotonic clock, TSC, and uptime together, rerun in real-time and coherently accelerated environments, and set safe resource budgets for loops without terminating branches prematurely.
  expected_effect:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 短分析窗口和不一致 sleep 跳过难以稳定识别沙箱，时间门控载荷可在对照运行中暴露。
      en: Short analysis horizons and inconsistent sleep skipping become unreliable sandbox indicators, and time-gated payloads can appear in controlled runs.
  limitations:
    paragraphs:
    - zh: 硬件计时和外部时间源难以全部控制，长真实延迟增加成本，资源耗尽攻击仍需独立限制。
      en: Hardware timing and external time sources cannot all be controlled easily, long real delays add cost, and resource-exhaustion attacks still need separate limits.
